episodes.172084: After a day of record heat, a cold front moved in producing elevated showers and thunderstorms that produced some strong to severe downburst winds.
episodes.172583: Thunderstorms pushing offshore from the Brevard and St Lucie County coasts produced strong wind gusts.
episodes.173036: Lightning strike causes tree collapse onto apartment complex near Fort Myers in Lee County.
episodes.173038: Late morning and afternoon thunderstorms produce a waterspout and gusty marine winds across coastal waters around west central and southwest Florida.
episodes.173095: Strong upper-level ridging persisted and was the dominated weather feature for several days. Record breaking high temperatures, near single digit RH, and strong winds gusts have led to a Red Flag Warning throughout the 4 days. Numerous fires sparked as a result of incapsulated erratic gusty winds associated with isolated dry thunderstorms. The breakdown of the upper-level ridge, onset of strong winds aloft, and the isolated dry thunderstorms was the trifecta that led to an extreme critical fire weather event.
episodes.173264: A thunderstorm briefly became severe as it approached the Newcastle area. The storm produced wind gusts near 60 mph.
episodes.173273: A front settled across the Altamaha River basin into the afternoon and became nearly stationary into the night across the local area as an upper-level impulse passed over the area. High moisture and weak SW steering flow < 10 kts produced locally heavy rainfall, especially near the front into the afternoon and evening.
episodes.173274: A front settled across the Altamaha River basin into the afternoon and became nearly stationary into the night across the local area as an upper-level impulse passed over the area. High moisture and weak SW steering flow < 10 kts produced locally heavy rainfall, especially near the front into the afternoon and evening.
episodes.173554: A few high based thunderstorms produced some severe wind gusts.
episodes.174078: Strong thunderstorms developed during the afternoon and caused damage in southwest Alabama.
episodes.174283: An upper level low pressure area over the NE Gulf of Mexico helped to produce a moist west to southwest wind flow across South Florida and the adjacent Gulf waters, leading to the formation of strong thunderstorms.
episodes.174500: A slow moving cold front draped across central Louisiana and Mississippi slowly but steadily moved southward through the local coastal waters. A warm and unstable environment was in place ahead of this front. The combination of lift from the front and buoyancy already in place provided a setup supportive for strong thunderstorm winds over various portions of the coastal waters as storms developed.
episodes.174522: An upper level disturbance moved across the region producing scattered thunderstorms. A couple storms became severe.
episodes.174528: An isolated severe thunderstorm produced wind damage in the city of Taft.
episodes.174530: An isolated thunderstorm moved over Nueces Bay and produced wind gusts to 34 knots.
